name: Atlassian MCP
description: Jira and Confluence from an MCP client, Cloud or Server/Data Center. Set JIRA_URL, a user and an API token, plus the CONFLUENCE_ ones for Confluence. MCP endpoint at /mcp. No auth of its own: anyone who reaches it gets the tools, so untick DNS-resolvable to keep it on the internal network, or put it behind a VPN.
